research.title: Vite 8 + Rolldown: The Migration That Cut Linear's Build From 46s to 6s
research.whyTrending: Vite 8 shipped stable March 12, 2026 with Rolldown (Rust) replacing both esbuild and Rollup, now several patches in (8.1.3, July 2). Official benchmark: 19k modules in 1.61s vs Rollup's 40.10s. The compat layer handles most config, so the real story is the failure mode - plugins that reach into Rollup or esbuild internals. A migration war-story with actual numbers, not another release summary.
